title: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'onnxscript'
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

PyTorch 2.9 no longer installs `onnxscript` by default. Packages relying on `torch.onnx.export` with dynamo=True now need to explicitly add `onnxscript` as a dependency.
